statements.statement: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations and lightheadedness
There is concern for paroxysmal atrial fibrillation
The patient has known nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency
The patient has a personal history of transient ischemic attack
The patient has a personal history of cerebral infarction
The denial reason code is CO-197
The denial was based on lack of required precertification or prior authorization
Continuous rhythm monitoring is indicated to assess for arrhythmic burden and guide anticoagulation management
